name: update
about: An 8-20 s update film ("vX is out"): a hook on the version, 2-4 changes each shown as a product moment, one payoff, the end card with the version. new-film.sh --format update lays these files over the Remotion starter.

music.about: Every update film is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): the track carries the film and earshot effects mark its hits; never effects only.
music.pick: the dealt direction lists tracks from the shortlist in its tempo range (python3 scripts/deck.py --show); 116-128 BPM suits the template's one bar a change
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --format update --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py edit --bars N --reveal-bar K --end stop|button|ring
